question.text: Per the Investor Charter Annexure, NAV of a Cat III OPEN-ENDED AIF scheme must be disclosed at what minimum frequency?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9 Annexure 9.1 Section D states: 'Disclosure of NAV of scheme(s) of the Category III Alternative Investment Fund: Close ended fund - quarterly basis; Open ended fund - monthly basis.' Monthly is the minimum for open-ended Cat III disclosure. The Trap: Option A over-discloses. Options C and D are close-ended/Cat I-II territory. Note: Page 247 of the workbook contains the Investor Charter NAV-disclosure table; page 350 provides related NAV disclosure context.
